Package com.stzteam.features.advantagekitbridge

Class MarsLoggableInput

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.advantagekitbridge.MarsLoggableInput
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.littletonrobotics.junction.inputs.LoggableInputs
public class MarsLoggableInput extends Object implements org.littletonrobotics.junction.inputs.LoggableInputs
Adapts any MARS Data snapshot into an AdvantageKit LoggableInputs.

This is the piece that makes an existing MARS subsystem loggable and replayable without touching its Data class. It reuses the exact convention ForgeMini's NetworkIO already expects -- public fields, with complex types carrying a static Struct field -- and targets a LogTable instead of NetworkTables.

A Data class that already implements LoggableInputs itself (for instance one generated by AdvantageKit's @AutoLog processor) does not need this adapter; AdvantageKitBridge detects that and hands the object straight to the logger.

Reuse across loops

The instance is designed to be created once per subsystem and retargeted every cycle via setTarget(Object). MARS calls its input hook once per subsystem per loop, so allocating an adapter there would mean a garbage object per subsystem at 50 Hz.

Threading

Not thread-safe, matching Logger.processInputs, which must be called from the main robot thread.
